resources.string: Don\'t want to train a skill, like the handstand or the flag? Switch it off. Its exercises stay greyed out and leave your skill progress. Tap a skill to switch off only its harder steps.
Switch off a step and every harder one goes too. Switch one on and the easier ones come back.
You\'ve switched off the %1$s skill, so this isn\'t part of your workouts or skill progress. Continue anyway?
Every exercise here belongs to a skill you switched off, so this class counts as passed. You can still do it.
